cd /home/user/rork-app

# The emulator's system_server keeps crashing under software emulation (no KVM).
# The APK was installed successfully once (confirmed: package:com.ivxholdings.app, boot_count=2).
# But system_server crashed again and the package was lost (cold boot, no snapshot).
# 
# Key evidence so far:
# - sys.boot_completed=1 was reached TWICE
# - APK install succeeded: "Success" with package:com.ivxholdings.app
# - App package info: versionCode=1, versionName=1.0, targetSdk=36, minSdk=24
# - But system_server keeps crashing under TCG software emulation, causing reboots
# - The APK was lost on reboot because it was installed during an unstable window
#
# Let me try one more approach: wait for the current boot to stabilize, install, and launch quickly

EMU_PID=$(cat /tmp/emulator-pid.txt 2>/dev/null)
echo "=== EMULATOR STATUS ==="
kill -0 $EMU_PID 2>/dev/null && echo "PID $EMU_PID ALIVE — uptime=$(ps -p $EMU_PID -o etime= 2>/dev/null)" || echo "PID $EMU_PID DEAD"

echo ""
echo "=== ADB DEVICES ==="
/opt/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb devices -l 2>&1

echo ""
echo "=== BOOT COMPLETION ==="
/opt/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb -s emulator-5554 shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'

echo ""
echo "=== PACKAGE MANAGER ==="
/opt/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb -s emulator-5554 shell pm list packages 2>&1 | head -5

echo ""
echo "=== SETTINGS PROVIDER ==="
/opt/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb -s emulator-5554 shell settings get global boot_count 2>&1 | tr -d '\r'

echo ""
echo "=== LOGCAT (last 10 lines) ==="
/opt/android-sdk/platform-tools/adb -s emulator-5554 logcat -d -t 10 2>&1
